patch:
diff --git a/src/click/flow_help_paragraphs.py b/src/click/flow_help_paragraphs.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a878d8d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/flow_help_paragraphs.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .formatting import HelpFormatter
+from .formatting import wrap_text
+
+
+class FlowHelpParagraphs(HelpFormatter):
+    def write_text(self, text: str) -> None:
+        """Writes re-indented text into the buffer."""
+        indent = " " * self.current_indent
+        self.write(
+            wrap_text(
+                text,
+                self.width,
+                initial_indent=indent,
+                subsequent_indent=indent,
+                preserve_paragraphs=False,
+            )
+        )
+        self.write("\n")
notes:
Created src/click/flow_help_paragraphs.py with FlowHelpParagraphs(HelpFormatter) whose write_text mirrors HelpFormatter.write_text but passes preserve_paragraphs=False to wrap_text; no existing modules touched.
